headline: 达琳·格雷姆任南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员
summary: 南卡罗来纳州州长亨利·麦克马斯特于2026年7月13日任命达琳·格雷姆填补林赛·格雷姆逝世留下的参议员空缺。她于7月14日宣誓就职。

sources.title: Gov. McMaster Appoints Darline Graham to the U.S. Senate
sources.publisher: 南卡罗来纳州州长办公室
sources.excerpt: COLUMBIA, S.C. — Governor Henry McMaster today announced the appointment of Darline Graham to the United States Senate to fill the vacancy created by the passing of U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham.

sources.title: DARLINE GRAHAM, SENATOR FOR SOUTH CAROLINA
sources.publisher: 美国参议员达琳·格雷姆办公室
sources.excerpt: appointed as a Republican to the United States Senate on July 13, 2026, to fill the vacancy caused by the death of Lindsey O. Graham; took the oath of office on July 14, 2026.
